desc: Parse all test cases, build lists of 1-indexed positions for `A` and `B`.
For each test case, if `len(posA) != len(posB)`, print `-1`.
Otherwise compute `sum(|posA[k] - posB[k]|)` over all matched pieces and print it.
Implement extraction of sorted positions from binary strings A and B for each test case.
Compute the max distance using the pairing `posA[k]` with `posB[min(k, len(posB)-1)]`.
Verify with all three sample test cases.
Handle edge cases: N=1, all 1s, no 1s (but constraints guarantee at least one 1 in each string).
